title: Kissed Bitter Middle Eastern Eggplant Baba Ganoush
description: A bitter and tender Middle Eastern dish featuring roasted eggplant, white vinegar, and a refreshing ice-bath shock, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This macrobiotic-friendly baba ganoush is a delicious and healthy alternative to traditional dips.

ingredients.name: eggplant
ingredients.notes: any variety, but purple works best

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the eggplants in half lengthwise and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the eggplants in the oven for 30 minutes, or until the skin is charred and the flesh is tender.
Remove the eggplants from the oven and immediately submerge them in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Once the eggplants have cooled, scoop out the flesh and place it in a blender or food processor.
Add the white vinegar, lemon juice, garlic, tahini, olive oil, salt, and black pepper to the blender and blend until smooth.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the baba ganoush to a serving bowl and garnish with parsley or other herbs, if desired.
Serve the baba ganoush with pita bread, vegetables, or crackers.
Refrigerate any leftovers for up to 3 days.
